(Vaikhānasa)_(Sundararāja_Ayyaṅgār)
alias ºBhaṭṭācārya (1841-1904 C.E.); belonged to Ilattūr in Shenkotta Taluk; known by his pet name ‘Cellam Ayyaṅgār’, son of Varadarāja Ayyaṅgār an. Kṛṣṇāmbikā of Ātreya gotra; disciple of Rāmasvāmi Śāstri (Gomatīdāsa) of Illatūr; honoured by Viśākam, Tirunāl an. Mūlam Tirunāl, Kings of Travancore an. Kerala Varma Valiya Koil Tampurān.
